notes.title: DUM Justice Delivered 💥 A Limited Time Event Wrap Up
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Crewmates![/p][p][/p][p]Just because [b][url="https://schellgames.com/blog/dum-justice-3d"]the Vigilante Role is here to stay permanently[/url] [/b]doesn't mean we can't do a cheeky little recap on the DUM Justice Limited Time Event! We LOVE to share data and insights with you.[/p][p][/p][p]Let's start with some gameplay stats...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/3cbe11b44a793f90eb4fc588784f187a6db16b8c.png"][/img][/p][p]The Vigilante Role grants a Crewmate the ability to Kill other beans — be it the Impostor or fellow Crewmates. However, it seems a majority of Vigilantes didn't go on a justice-fueled rampage. 💢 Of all the deaths during the Limited Time Event, 63.46% were done by Impostors and [b]only 36.54% were performed by Vigilantes[/b]! ⚖️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/465be89be209bf1428444f8dedf177cf498fbf78.png"][/img][/p][p]Whether brought on by evil or well-intentioned justice, the number of unalivings during the DUM Justice event went wild! ☠️ [b]Over one million beans were killed! [/b]That's a lot of bones! 🦴[/p][p][/p][p]45% of these kills happened in lobbies where only one death occurred. So, that's either some really great deductive work 🔎... or speaks highly of Vigilante precision! 🔭 Alternatively, only 23 matches during the entire event period saw nine bean deaths in the same match. 🤯 Now THAT's stealth skill![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/c7304afc3de0e4d203ec8e89c7c82d4461b2d465.png"][/img][/p][p]Looking at color preference, it's not too shocking that 🔴 Red remains the most used Bean. We've seen this since essentially the beginning of time.[/p][p][/p][p]And yet... look how close ⚫ Gray is on taking the lead! Could it be possible for a color popularity upset after the Critical Cargo event?! 😱 We'll have to find out.[/p][p][/p][p]Obligatory #JusticeForBrown as well. 🤎 We're rooting for you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/6a6a94a9739b03c92a9d2cd90b1091605059c020.png"][/img][/p][p]On the note of popularity, we're seeing some pretty expected results for the most used cosmetics as well:[/p][list][*][p]Red bean ❤️[/p][/*][*][p]Fedorable Hat 🎩[/p][/*][*][p]Git Gud Gloves 🕹️[/p][/*][*][p]Suited Up Skin 👔[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Clearly the majority of our Crewmate player-base are distinguished, dignified, and fashionable gamers. Who would've guessed?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/e358704defa6d34a1eaf0e2ea943400eeb2725a0.png"][/img][/p][p]Keeping on topic, all five of the Vigilante-themed cosmetics performed fairly well. Most notably, the [b]Caped Crewsader[/b] skin was the SECOND most used during the event, only losing out to the [b]Suited Up[/b] skin. It's giving 💵 billionaire philanthropist secret identity by day... Vigilante hero by night vibes. Right? 🦇[/p][p][/p][p]Rank 32 and Rank 44, for the [b]Vigilante Mask: Year One[/b] and [b]Vigilante Hood[/b] hats respectively, may not seem too popular... but consider this: if you exclude all of the free hat options, they instead come in at Rank 2 and Rank 11! Curious what the most popular hat would be instead? It's the [b]Plagued[/b] mask! ☣️[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/b21d7295dcc3310fbf1b3a6ccd9c32f417a81905.png"][/img]
We can't wait to see how these stats will change when we scan-alyze the [b][url="https://schellgames.com/blog/critical-cargo-owners-manual"]Critical Cargo Limited Time Event[/url][/b]! 📦Especially with all of the exciting ✨ [b][url="https://schellgames.com/blog/critical-cargo-among-us-3d"]Weekly Cosmetic Drops[/url][/b] ✨ planned throughout the event — [i]new items drop every Thursday[/i]![/p][p][/p][p]Stay suspicious, Crewmates![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/16f4c791123072c30e1cc65b4af86e01618cc42f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Scan with a Plan 📡 Critical Cargo is Now Live
notes.notes: [p]Scan you believe it? Critical Cargo, our new Limited Time Event (LTE), has officially come to [i]Among Us 3D[/i]. Expect an all new mechanic 📡 along with a new role ✨, new game mode 📦, and new cosmetics 🚀 as you engage in behavior that is simply Scan-dalous. [/p][p][/p][h2]New Mode, Mechanic & Role[/h2][previewyoutube="59ebBtKIOGE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Get ready for [b]Critical Cargo[/b], a special mode available exclusively on the Skeld II. This mode introduces a brand new role: the ✨ [b]Critical Crewmate[/b] ✨. Protect these beans at all costs! If all of the Critical Crewmates get killed by the Impostors, the entire Crewmate team loses — regardless of how many Crewmates remain! ☠️[/p][p][/p][p]How do you know if someone is a Critical Crewmate? 🤔 Easy*! All beans have been equipped with a handy B.E.A.N.S. Suit Scanner with a reliable* "[b]Scan[/b]" ability![/p][p][/p][p]🔎[i] *Note: Scans aren't always reliable and may produce inconclusive results, making things not necessarily "easy."[/i][/p][p][/p][p]How does the Scanner work? 📡 After completing a set of tasks, Crewmates will gain the Scan ability. Scan a Bean next to you and one of three results will appear, indicating a Crewmate ([i]yay[/i] 🥳), try again ([i]boo[/i] 😞), or Critical Crewmate/Impostor ([i]aaahhhh[/i] 😱). Complete additional tasks for more Scans.[/p][p][/p][p]Impostors in this mode are more dangerous than ever. Even though they don't have the Scan ability, the Impostors are able to see a general status of every bean from the beginning! 😲 If someone seems to know way too much about roles around the Emergency Meeting table… that's your Impostor. Probably. 😅[/p][p][/p][p]Want to know even more? Check out [url="https://schellgames.com/blog/critical-cargo-owners-manual"]the Owner's Manual[/url] for this new mode![/p][p][/p][h2]Introducing Weekly Cosmetics! 💅[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/e9ad680b6ced92b6f65f558c9b823345d8b4e516.png"][/img][/p][p]If you love customizing your Bean, this LTE might be the best time to find the fit you've been looking for. Two new bundles are now available, including the basic [b]B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000[/b] and the deluxe [b]B.E.A.N.S. Suit 9001[/b] upgrade. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Quick Fun Fact:[/b] [i]Every Bean starts Critical Cargo mode with a Scanner, replacing any other Hat cosmetic. However — you can purchase the golden B.E.A.N.S. Suit 9001 model scanner to replace the basic grey version to show off in the new mode (and after)! [/i]✨[/p][p][/p][p][b]Disclaimer:[/b] [i]Wearing the B.E.A.N.S. Suit 9001 Scanner does not increase the probability of conclusive scans or alter gameplay in any way. Other than making you look super elite and special. [/i]⭐ [/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/b21d7295dcc3310fbf1b3a6ccd9c32f417a81905.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/8a288a4c492c17fe280fa01dc25d0e7b2670cda4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/25464e876e2d318ca0fc07281a3f2e31b8db190b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/fa28cd17293305dce4f2f5407d694f18299a8978.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Starting today, we will also be introducing 📅 [b]Weekly Cosmetic Drops[/b] 💅 into the [i]Among Us 3D[/i] in-game store. You can see hints of some of the upcoming items in our latest trailer, but we'll also spell them out here.[/p][list][*][p]New Outfit Combos - 🦑 [b]Squid Pro Quo[/b] Hat and [b]Cephalobod[/b] Skin 🦑[/p][/*][*][p]New Skins - 🏄‍♀️ [b]Hang 10[/b] and 🦺 [b]Going Overboard[/b][/p][/*][*][p]New Hats - 🐢 [b]Shell Shocked[/b], 🐟 [b]Got a Bite on the Line[/b], and 🚧 [b]Miner's Setback (Brown)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]New Gloves - 🎣 [b]Catch of the Day[/b] and 🌴 [b]Coastal Charm[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/1db4e380130a0e125efb7fec5a3b880647e3c439.png"][/img][/p][h2]Roadmap 🗺️[/h2][p][/p][p]Alongside this update, we realized we already did everything set out [url="https://schellgames.com/blog/au3d-roadmap-2025"]in our 2025 Roadmap[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Does this mean we stop? notes.title: Your B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000 Owner's Manual
notes.notes:
[p][b]Welcome, valued Crewmate, to the future of interstellar accountability! [/b]We've received your order for [b]Critical Cargo[/b], and expect your delivery to take place on [b]July 31, 2025[/b].[/p][p]You are now the proud owner of the Better Evaluation And kNowledge Suit, or as we like to call it, the [b]B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000[/b]. This state-of-the-art, full-body attire is more than just a fashion statement; it’s your first and last line of defense against an early expiration in electrical.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/9807fdbc3f074cf65f36068d0a341a022e9648a5.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Unboxing your B.E.A.N.S.[/b][/h2][p]Upon unboxing your B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000, you should find:[/p][list][*][p][b]One (1) Skin: B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000 Suit: [/b]Available in any color you want, as long as it's grey.[/p][/*][*][p][b]One (1) 1 Pair of Gloves: B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000 Gloves: [/b]Perfect for rewiring, refueling, and redirecting blame to another.[/p][/*][*][p][b]One (1) Hat: B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000 Scanner: [/b]Attaches to your visor. Do NOT try to detach it. You'll just break it, and returns take forever in space.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/3e33979e7654058591fe96ef620d4e17616d3516.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Powering Your Suit (It's Basically PJs with Sci-Fi Bits)[/b][/h2][p]Putting on the B.E.A.N.S. Suit is as easy as jumping into your favorite onesie. The advanced, patent-pending fabric will automatically contour to your bean-like physique. Yes, your butt looks great.[/p][p]The Scanner will then magnetically affix itself to your cranium with a satisfying clunk. What is it adhered to? Don't worry about it.[/p][p]Your B.E.A.N.S. Suit starts with zero (0) charges and must be manually [b]powered by completing tasks[/b]. Subsequent task completion will supply additional scans, allowing Beans to Scan to their heart's content.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/36b6954328a612ff78bb09baae9abdb5561b9889.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Using Your Scanner (No, It Doesn't Display Power Levels)[/b][/h2][p]Forget fumbling with handheld devices! The B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000 features a state-of-the-art, head-mounted scanner for optimal, hands-free suspicion. It's science, but for your face.[/p][list][*][p][b]Charge your Scanner.[/b] Do your tasks. No, we’re not just yelling at you to get a Crewmate victory. Our patented technology grants a Crewmate one full Scan per each complete set of tasks completed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Choose a "Friend."[/b] Look directly at the Crewmate you find most suspicious. Maybe they took the last donut.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Activate the Scanner.[/b] Give the Scan button a firm, confident tap to execute your Scan. If you see double the Crewmates, you tapped too hard.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Maintain Visual Contact.[/b] Stare them down. Make it awkward. The Scanner needs a few seconds to penetrate from their suit to their very soul. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Receive Your Verdict.[/b] A final, definitive result will flash across your Scanner's Heads-Up Display.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/c268c056ffa98d2f57cc1cfeb34570e11e35477e.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Understanding Your Scan (Displayed Directly over the Suspected Party)[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/ad92ed7b658573750d6cc3dcb2ff7ce680cb660a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]CREWMATE[/b][/p][p]The Scanner reveals a calming light green Bean with a checkmark. Phew. This Bean is on your team. They are a certified, task-completing buddy. Now you can both follow each other around until one decides not to trust the other and you both lose.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/5bbc6b6c1299e530334a5e2ae3874b66e84fb32d.png"][/img][/p][p][b]INCONCLUSIVE[/b][/p][p]B.E.A.N.S. Suit 3000 Scans are 100% accurate. However, due to anomalies with shipping to your planet/starship via wormhole, your Scan may not work 100% of the time.[/p][p]An orange, blurred bean with a repeat signal means your Scanner needs to try again, and results are inconclusive. Time to do your tasks and recharge![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/6b5f4fbf73c400b797c96d827502913e2dd96e0b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/p][p]The Scanner displays a pink-hued Bean with an exclamation point. Jackpot! This Bean is either a Critical Crewmate OR an Impostor. [b]Critical Crewmates[/b] are V.I.B.s (Very Important Beans). Protect them. Even if they are really bad at tasks. Remember, if all of them are eliminated, it's an instant loss for the Crewmates![/p][p]Once you've figured out your Scan, it's time for your hero moment. Confidently call an Emergency Meeting and completely fail to explain your evidence.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/ed9a69f441aeeb8f31390d4ec524572eae8d8135.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]But Wait... I'm an Impostor[/b][/h2][p]Thanks for your honesty! A galactic patrol will be by shortly to assist in jettisoning you out of the nearest airlock.[/p][p]Impostors can don the B.E.A.N.S. suit, but [b]Impostors cannot Scan[/b]. Impostors may notice a weird product opportunity (we legally can't call it a glitch) where they receive a list of targets, including the Critical Crewmates, instead. The UI of the B.E.A.N.S. Suit Scanner will showcase indicators next to all seen beans, giving indication of their Crewmate or Critical Crewmate status likelihood.[/p][p]﻿﻿In other words, Impostors reap the benefit of the Scan functionality... [b]without needing to actually ﻿Scan[/b]. So, if someone seems to know too much too quickly, they probably need to be ejected!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/68ce73e7178b1a3c43ac8582153be4df6c4fb3c8.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Upgrade Your Fit[/b][/h2][p]All Beans start each round bedecked in their standard-issue Scanner. But maybe you feel a bit basic. Perhaps you wish your judgmental glares carried more prestige? [/p][p]Then you need the BEST Evaluation And kNowledge Suit — the [b]B.E.A.N.S. Suit 9001 Deluxe Edition[/b]! Our newest model comes with all the standard functionality, but with an incredible new color scheme (modified each cycle for the latest color trends) and, get this,[/p][p][b]A GLEAMING, GOLD* SCANNER[/b][/p][p]That’s right, [b]GOLD*![/b] Forged in the heart of a dying star, this golden Scanner does everything the old one did, but with unimaginable style. Convey an aura of authority and trust and make fellow Crewmates think, "Now there's a crewmate who invests in quality. They are definitely not the Impostor."[/p][p][b]Don't delay! The Vigilante is no HERO, they're a MENACE!!![/p][p][/p][p]So, dear readers, I'm turning my call to you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/74318a975a0a6a99570376c6f66004ac23691754.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]📸 GET ME PICTURES OF THE VIGILANTE! 📸[/h2][p][/p][p]That's right. notes.title: Among Us 3D: What a Launch Week! 🎉 + A Note on Voice Chat & Moderation
notes.notes:
Wow. What an incredible few days since [i]Among Us 3D[/i] launched on May 6! From the overwhelming support to the hilarious in-game moments you’ve shared, we’re so grateful to have such a passionate, creative, and chaotic crew with us. 💖

So let’s take a minute to celebrate what’s been going on, and also talk about a few things we know you’ve been asking about.

[h2]🚀 Community Highlights: You’ve Been Busy![/h2]

[b]Streams That Made Us Laugh (and Cry Laughing)[/b]
#ICYMI, the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2452012558]TriHouse stream[/url] had us absolutely rolling. He was joined by [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2452013167]Jojosolos[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4xgghmJDG3Q]VR Central[/url], and members of the [i]Among Us 3D [/i]dev team to kick off launch day with a Steam store page stream. We don’t want to spoil anything, but let’s just say the betrayal was real—and loud.

[previewyoutube=4xgghmJDG3Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Fan Art Galore 🎨[/b]
We’ve seen some wild and wonderful creations pop up already—including a gorgeous reimagining of the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RgefpoJ3IoM]Among Us 3D Bean-lieve launch trailer[/url] that completely blew us away. Please keep sharing your art, videos, theories, and cosplay—we’re watching, and we’re loving it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/bd64d8ad66a07dbef574a988135744f592f2fd70.png[/img]
Credit: [url=https://x.com/shiba2mofu/status/1920094373536010609]Shiba2mofu[/url]

[b]Live from PAX: Crewmates in the Wild[/b]
If you’re at PAX East this weekend, members of the [i]Among Us 3D[/i] team are hanging out at Schell Games booth #18109 so you can experience betrayal live from the show floor! We love connecting with fans and seeing the sheer panic that occurs when players round a corner to come face to face with The Infected. Play the game, meet the dev team, and purchase an exclusive [i]Among Us 3D[/i] Pinny Arcade pin at our booth. You are the best Crewmates (and Impostors) we could ask for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505928/dab483a4a70b5200118bdb31e4a39ac6dfc52db9.jpg[/img]

[b]🔧 About Voice Chat Moderation, Reports, and Safety[/b]

Okay—now let’s talk about something we know has been coming up a lot: voice chat moderation and bans.

First off, yes, we definitely see the feedback. Thank you for sharing your experiences. Moderation in a voice-heavy, social deduction game is complex, and we’re constantly fine-tuning what’s okay, what’s not, and how we respond. But that kind of nuance takes time.

Here’s what we want you to know:

[list][*]We care about your safety. Moderation for any sort of multiplayer game - whether or chat or voice - has long existed. ToxMod, the service we use, is one you may have seen in other games like Rec Room or Call of Duty. It’s important to have something like this to ensure chat isn’t filled with harassment, hate speech, and other toxic behaviour. As far as moderation tools go, this is standard procedure![/list]

[list][*]No, we’re not selling your data (or voice). Period. The way most basic automated moderation tools work is to analyze the chat for toxic behaviour. (Which gets flagged and leads into our next bullet point.) This technology has been around for awhile, and this type of machine learning is not the same as generative AI. If you would like more information, you can view ToxMod’s privacy and data management [url=https://www.modulate.ai/privacy-and-data]here[/url], or their full privacy policy [url=https://www.modulate.ai/privacy-policy]here[/url].[/list]

[list][*]Context matters, and that's why we have a human moderation team. Although the moderation AI helps our team manage volume, it is not the sole, unchecked decision maker. We know the human touch is important.[/list]

[list][*]Private lobbies aren’t exempt from the [url=https://www.innersloth.com/code-of-conduct/]Code of Conduct[/url]. We get it—playing with friends is a different vibe, but we still want to ensure that everyone feels safe and respected in-game. Having private lobbies with no moderation also is a huge security issue, since unchecked online spaces can sometimes become unsafe.[/list]

[list][*]We keep things consistent across all games. Our code of conduct has been with us for a long time, and one set of guidelines apply to [i]Among Us, Among Us 3D, and Among Us 3D: VR[/i].[/list]

[list][*]This is an iterative process. We’re not perfect yet, but we’re listening and improving every day.[/list]

[list][*]We’re trying to balance freedom and safety. Our goal is to let players be themselves without making others feel uncomfortable or unsafe.[/list]

[list][*]If something doesn’t seem right or you think we missed the mark, please make a report or appeal a ban on the [url=https://amongus3dsupport.schellgames.com/]Among Us 3D player support site[/url]. Your feedback genuinely helps us land on the right answer.[/list]

🫶 [b]Thanks for Being Here[/b]
We’re committed to making [i]Among Us 3D[/i] the best experience it can be—for everyone. Whether you’ve been suspicious from day one or just hopped aboard the Skeld II, thank you for being part of this wild, spacefaring journey.

We can’t wait to see what you come up with next.

Stay suspicious, Beans!

notes.title: Among Us 3D Frequently Ask Questions
notes.notes:
[b]What is [i]Among Us 3D[/i]?[/b]
You've asked, we've listened. [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3168600/Among_Us_3D/]Among Us 3D[/url][/i] is a crossplay experience that brings the first-person aesthetic introduced in [i]Among Us VR[/i] to Steam PC players. The game will feature the same intense, fast-paced gameplay, complete with voice chat, new customization options, game modes, roles, and all the deception-filled fun—without the need for a VR headset.

It also is the umbrella name for this way to play [i]Among Us[/i]. Over the coming months,[i] Among Us VR[/i] will be rebranded to [i]Among Us 3D[/i] — joining the [i]Among Us 3D[/i] family. If it makes it easier for you, [i]Among Us 3D[/i] is all-encompassing but usually refers to the PC (mouse and keyboard/controller) version of the game; meanwhile, [i]Among Us 3D: VR[/i] is the version that requires a VR headset to play.

[b]When does [i]Among Us 3D[/i] come out for PC players?![/b]
We haven't announced an official release date yet, beans. PATIENCE!

[b]What platforms will [i]Among Us 3D[/i] be on?[/b]
The PC version of [i]Among Us 3D[/i] will launch on Steam later this year.

[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1849900/Among_Us_VR/]Among Us 3D: VR[/url][/i] — which is currently still called [i]Among Us VR[/i] — is already available; it launched on November 10, 2022, on the [url=https://www.meta.com/experiences/among-us-vr/4948428055244413/]Meta Horizon store[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1849900/Among_Us_VR/]SteamVR[/url], and on December 5, 2023, for [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10005565]PlayStation VR2[/url] and [url=https://store-global.picoxr.com/global/detail/1/7257172372246020102]PICO[/url] headsets!

[b]Can I crossplay with the original [i]Among Us[/i]?[/b]
No. Sorry, beans. It's just not possible. [i]Among Us 3D[/i] will not be crossplay-compatible with the original [i]Among Us[/i].

HOWEVER — the game WILL be crossplay with all VR versions of the game (ie. Meta, SteamVR, PlayStation VR2, and PICO players). Prepare to join a large community of Crewmates on Day One!

[b]So... What is happening with [i]Among Us VR[/i]?[/b]
Over the coming months, [i]Among Us VR[/i] will be rebranded to join the [i]Among Us 3D[/i] family. The rebrand is mostly aesthetic — a new title, new logo, new start up screen — and is meant to highlight the connectivity and crossplay features with [i]Among Us 3D[/i]. After the launch of [i]Among Us 3D[/i] for Steam PC, all versions of the game, including the VR versions, will be updated similarly and simultaneously to stay current with each other.

This game is currently available on Meta Quest, Steam VR, PlayStation VR2, and PICO.

[b]If I own [i]Among Us VR[/i], do I have to buy [i]Among Us 3D[/i]?[/b]
Yes. While crossplay features are available in the games, [i]Among Us 3D[/i] and [i]Among Us VR[/i] are considered separate games.

If you owned [i]Among Us 3D:VR[/i] on or before launch day (May 6), you would have received Among Us 3D (the PC version) for free.

After [i]Among Us 3D[/i] officially launches on Steam, we'll be bundling the two versions together, offering current VR players a chance to grab the PC version at a discounted price.

[b]What about my [i]Among Us VR[/i] cosmetics? Do I have to rebuy the DLC Packs all over again?[/b]
We'll have a lot more to share about updates to DLC, cosmetics, and the Wardrobe very soon. But, the short answer is: "Steam cross-buy compatibility!"

[b]Do you have more information to share regarding Stardust, the newly announced in-game currency?[/b]
We plan to provide more information about Stardust with you in the upcoming weeks.

[b]Can I connect my Innersloth Account tied to [i]Among Us [/i]with [i]Among Us 3D[/i]?[/b]
[i]Among Us 3D[/i] does not integrate with the Innersloth accounts system. This also plays into the fact that [i]Among Us 3D[/i] will not be crossplay compatible with the original [i]Among Us[/i]. (We'll keep reiterating this fact, promise.)

[b]Why aren't [i]Among Us 3D[/i] and [i]Among Us VR[/i] the same game?[/b]
There are several answers to this question. However, the simplest (ie, least technical jargon — we're trying to save you, beans) explanation is that [i]Among Us 3D[/i]'s control schemes, UI, and backend systems were built from the ground up. Separating the versions during this development allowed/allows us to continue to bring quality updates to our [i]Among Us VR[/i] beans while ensuring the highest quality and tailored experience for our new PC players.

[b]How many players can play?[/b]
[i]Among Us 3D[/i] features lobbies from 4 - 10 players at one time. This is consistent with [i]Among Us VR[/i], but different from the original [i]Among Us[/i] game.

[b]How does voice chat work in [i]Among Us 3D[/i]?[/b]
Proximity chat is integrated into the game natively! Players can also choose to use quick text chat options or the new "Gesture" system to communicate without voice as well.

[b]How many maps will be available in [i]Among Us 3D[/i]?[/b]
[i]Among Us 3D[/i] will launch with the Skeld II and Polus Point map from [i]Among Us VR[/i].

[b]How can I play [i]Among Us 3D[/i] early?[/b]
[i]Among Us 3D[/i] will be a part of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest]Steam Next Fest[/url]! From Monday, February 24, 2025, until Monday, March 3, 2025, players can download the [i]Among Us 3D[/i] Demo and get early access to the game for this limited time. This version of the game does not include all features or game modes that will be available at launch, such as crossplay compatibility with [i]Among Us VR[/i] or additional cosmetics. The demo is exclusive to players 16 years or older.
